Risk_Description: Vendors may be onboarded without mandatory GSTIN verification or statutory checks
Control_Description: Automated API verification of GSTIN against GST portal and dual management sign-off on vendor creation
Audit_Procedure: Sample 25 new vendors added during the year. Verify GST portal active status and approval notes.

Risk_Description: Purchase orders may be split to circumvent Delegation of Authority (DOA) financial thresholds
Control_Description: ERP checks cumulative PO values per vendor within 30 days and blocks split POs exceeding 5 Lakhs
Audit_Procedure: Extract procurement dump and run script to identify duplicate PO dates and split amounts.

Risk_Description: Payments processed without valid 3-way match (PO, GRN, and Vendor Invoice)
Control_Description: Automated 3-way matching in SAP S/4HANA with tolerance limit of 0.5% for freight
Audit_Procedure: Sample 30 invoice payments. Verify matching quantities, rates, and GRN acceptance notes.

Risk_Description: Unauthorized wire transfers or bank payments bypassing maker-checker controls
Control_Description: Net banking corporate portal enforces dual authorization with OTP and digital signature tokens
Audit_Procedure: Inspect bank audit logs for 100% payments above 25 Lakhs. Verify two distinct authorizers.

Risk_Description: Capitalization of operational expenses or unrecorded asset disposals
Control_Description: Quarterly physical verification of fixed assets by independent administration team reconciled to FAR
Audit_Procedure: Review physical verification report and trace 20 tagged assets to physical locations.
